• LONG, SHORT and DAY are all fully broker-aware and can run on Alpaca and IBKR at the same time (each as its own isolated sub-portfolio).

Reminder: IBKR cloud is paper-only (live needs Mobile 2FA, which can't be approved on a headless server).
